name: site-control
description: Firebase tooling for the Ayush Enterprises app (emulators, security-rule tests, deploys)

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/emulators.test.json --project demo-site-control-test --only firestore "node --test firebase/tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix web run build && firebase deploy --only hosting --project prod
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.functest.json --project demo-site-control-fn --only firestore,functions "node --test functions/test/notify.test.mjs"
